detail.query:
UNLOAD (

SELECT
    CAST(num_poliza AS VARCHAR) AS numero_de_poliza,
    CAST(per_expedicion_pension AS VARCHAR) AS periodo_de_expedicion_de_la_poliza,
    CAST(dsc_origen AS VARCHAR) AS origen_de_la_renta,
    CAST(CAST(vlr_total AS DECIMAL(38,0)) AS VARCHAR) AS valor_auxilio_funerario_pagado,
    CAST(per_envio_tesoreria AS VARCHAR) AS mes_de_pago
FROM "niif-dev-gold-catalog-db"."scd_auxilios_funerarios"
WHERE CAST(per_envio_tesoreria AS VARCHAR) = '$period'
  AND act_reg = 1
ORDER BY numero_de_poliza

)
TO 's3://$assets_bucket/athena/notifications/unload/$execution_id/'
WITH (
    format = 'TEXTFILE',
    field_delimiter = '|',
    compression = 'NONE'
);

summary.query:
SELECT
    rst.origen_de_la_renta,
    COUNT(*) AS no_registros,
    CAST(SUM(rst.valor_auxilio_funerario_pagado) AS DECIMAL(38,0)) AS valor
FROM (
    SELECT
        CAST(num_poliza AS VARCHAR) AS numero_de_poliza,
        CAST(per_expedicion_pension AS VARCHAR) AS periodo_de_expedicion_de_la_poliza,
        CAST(dsc_origen AS VARCHAR) AS origen_de_la_renta,
        CAST(vlr_total AS DECIMAL(38,0)) AS valor_auxilio_funerario_pagado,
        CAST(per_envio_tesoreria AS VARCHAR) AS mes_de_pago
    FROM "niif-dev-gold-catalog-db"."scd_auxilios_funerarios"
    WHERE CAST(per_envio_tesoreria AS VARCHAR) = '$period'
      AND act_reg = 1
) rst
GROUP BY rst.origen_de_la_renta;
